summary: Computes the discount in cents from a coupon code, adds a 500-cent VIP bonus when applicable, and returns the discount capped to the subtotal.
inputs: self (object): Instance providing the coupons mapping used for lookup.
self.coupons (mapping[str, int]): Mapping of uppercase coupon codes to discount amounts in cents.
customer (Customer): Customer whose tier may trigger a VIP bonus.
subtotal_cents (int): Subtotal amount in cents used to cap the discount.
coupon (str): Coupon code string; empty or falsy means no discount.
outputs: applied_discount_cents (int): Final discount in cents to apply, 0 if no coupon, includes VIP bonus when applicable and is capped to the subtotal.
main_effect: Return the minimum of discount and subtotal_cents
